name: std::ranges::zip_view<Views...>::end

declarations.code:
constexpr auto end() const

    requires(ranges::range<const Views> && ...);

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: An iterator or sentinel representing the end of the zip_view, as described above.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: ranges::range<const ranges::zip_view<Views...>> is modeled if and only if for every type Vi in Views..., const Vi models range.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Build a zip_view over the arrays below, read the first item, and move to the next position.

summary: Returns an iterator or a sentinel that compares equal to the end iterator of the zip_view.
